body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> TOOSUN presented its portable power solution ‘M Power Plus(model: LP400)’ during KES 2007, which provides electric power for outdoor light bulb, heating/cooling appliance and digital device. The M Power Plus is also equipped with portable amplifier and speaker offering up to 20 hours of use at outdoor events. Suggested price is 484,000(KRW).
